title: Business Plan Development
modules: Concept And Importance Of A Business Plan
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the total instrument and plans aimed at achieving the objectives of marketing services and products in an organisation."
Marketing strategy can be defined as the total instrument and plans aimed at achieving the objectives of marketing services and products in an organisation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an estimate of future financial outcomes for a company, and it's an integral part of the annual budget process."
A financial forecast is an estimate of future financial outcomes for a company, and it's an integral part of the annual budget process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of gathering information about your market, customers and competitors."
Market research is the process of gathering information about your market, customers and competitors.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a road map or tool directing a business owner to know where you are going and how to get there."
Business plan is a road map or tool directing a business owner to know where you are going and how to get there.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a strategy employed by an organisation to reduce the effect of business risk."
Risk mitigation is a strategy employed by an organisation to reduce the effect of business risk.
fib: ______ is a guide for evaluating a business or individual's financial situation.
Financial analysis is a guide for evaluating a business or individual's financial situation.
______ can be defined as the process of identifying what may cause harm to your business and your workers.
A risk assessment can be defined as the process of identifying what may cause harm to your business and your workers.
______ is the last section in the business plan which includes all supporting materials.
Appendix is the last section in the business plan which includes all supporting materials.
